Who We Are

Most projects break at the seams — between the maker, the supplier and the installer. Adit Group was built to remove the seams.

Adit Group is an integrated ELV, security and system integration enterprise. Under one roof we manufacture the hardware, distribute it through a national channel, and integrate it on site — then stay accountable long after handover.

Three brands, one chain of responsibility: Avtron builds it, Adit Innovation supplies it, and Cyber Info installs, commissions and owns it.
